capabilities: Arrange a home page with folder cards, clock, background image and quick search
Manage calendar events in a vault .ics file with month, week and day views
Track long-term tasks on kanban boards backed by Markdown files
Read, send and search IMAP mail and turn messages into notes or events
Read EPUB, PDF, MOBI and other e-books and watch fund and stock quotes
extras: Mail view is desktop only. First run auto-downloads the NyaLingo plugin (network required, then one reload). Authorization codes are stored AES-256-GCM encrypted locally. The author solicits donations via QR codes.
problem: Obsidian has no single entry page combining calendar, tasks, mail and reading, so users must open separate views or plugins for each.

relations.evidence: mail and note translation use the shared NyaLingo plugin
NyaReader is the companion multi-format reader

requires.name: IMAP/SMTP, Microsoft, Google or CalDAV account

summary: Unified home page that gathers quick search, folder cards, clock, calendar, task boards, mail, e-book reading and market quotes in one view.
